schedule_task.title: Status every two hours [wizloop:interval-hours]
schedule_task.prompt:
[wizloop:interval-hours] A scheduled run of the loop file adapters/fixtures/t3/interval-hours.md. Do these steps in order. TIME below means the time now in UTC, as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

1. Do this:
Post one status line, only if something changed.

2. Last, append `TIME interval-hours ok WHAT` to .openwiz/home/interval-hours/ok.log, where WHAT is one line saying what you did; or, if step 1 failed, `TIME interval-hours failed WHY`.
